description:
Public enums and structs across library crates lack #[non_exhaustive], making every new variant/field a breaking change.

Locations:
- kith-core/src/auth.rs: Role, Identity
- kith-core/src/error.rs: AuthError, KithError
- kith-peer/src/lib.rs: PeerDeliveryError
- kithd/src/tls.rs: TlsError
- kithd/src/extractors.rs: CallerRejection
- kithd/src/listener.rs: ListenerError
- kith-tui/src/client.rs: ClientError, SseStatus
- kith-jmap/src/lib.rs: Session, CoreCapability, Capabilities, AccountCapabilities, Dispatcher, etc.
- kith-store/src/lib.rs: PeerBlobInfo

Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to all public enums, structs, and error types in library crates.
title: Public enums/structs across workspace missing #[non_exhaustive]
